research.topic: Persistent low mood (dysthymia) – a long‑standing, mild but draining feeling of sadness that can hide behind “just being a teen”
research.hook: Nobody tells you that feeling ‘just a bit sad’ for months can actually be a warning sign.
research.tip: Set a 60‑second timer three times a day, pause, breathe, and silently label one thought and one feeling.
dropped: Dysthymia is defined by a depressed mood most days for at least 2 years in adults and 1 year in adol (unsupported)
Approximately 2‑3 % of teens worldwide experience persistent low mood (WHO surveys). (uncertain + number not backed)
Common symptoms include low energy, poor concentration, low self‑esteem, and prolonged anhedonia. (unsupported)
Students with dysthymia score 5‑10 % lower on continuous assessment (NIMHANS). (unsupported)
Persistent low mood raises the risk of later major depressive episodes (APA longitudinal data). (unsupported)
Only about 30 % of teens with dysthymia seek professional help (WHO 2022). (uncertain + number not backed)
A 60‑second micro‑mindful pause three times daily can reduce rumination and improve mood stability i (unsupported)

data.title: Sad rehna kya sirf ek phase hai
data.title_en: Is feeling sad just a phase

scenes.text: Koi nahi batata mahino tak sad rehna warning hai.
scenes.text_en: Nobody tells you that being sad for months is a warning.
scenes.text_hi: कोई नहीं बताता महीनों तक सैड रहना वार्निंग है।

scenes.text: Kya tumhein lagta hai board exam pressure se tum lazy ho rahe ho?
scenes.text_en: Do you think board exam pressure is making you feel lazy?
scenes.text_hi: क्या तुम्हें लगता है बोर्ड एग्जाम प्रेशर से तुम लेज़ी हो रहे हो?

scenes.text: Ye ek lambe samay tak chala aane wala low mood hai.
scenes.text_en: This is a long‑lasting low mood that can persist for years.
scenes.text_hi: ये एक लंबे समय तक चलने वाला लो मूड है।

scenes.text: Ye school ke grades par bhi impact daal sakta hai.
scenes.text_en: It can also impact your school grades.
scenes.text_hi: ये स्कूल के ग्रेड्स पर भी इम्पैक्ट डाल सकता है।

scenes.text: Aur teesra point sunna sabse zyada zaroori hai doston.
scenes.text_en: And the third point is the most important to hear, friends.
scenes.text_hi: और तीसरा पॉइंट सुनना सबसे ज़्यादा ज़रूरी है दोस्तों।

scenes.text: Kya tum bina wajah meh aur low feel karte ho?
scenes.text_en: Do you feel meh and low without any reason?
scenes.text_hi: क्या तुम बिना वजह मेह और लो फील करते हो?

scenes.text: Ye us dost ko bhejo jo har waqt tired hai.
scenes.text_en: Send this to that friend who is tired all the time.
scenes.text_hi: ये उस दोस्त को भेजो जो हर वक़्त टायर्ड है।

scenes.text: Concentration mein dikkat aur hobbies mein interest kam hona.
scenes.text_en: Difficulty in concentration and loss of interest in hobbies.
scenes.text_hi: कंसंट्रेशन में दिक्कत और हॉबीज़ में इंटरेस्ट कम होना।

scenes.text: Apne feelings ko likho aur samjho.
scenes.text_en: Write down your feelings and try to understand them.
scenes.text_hi: अपने फीलिंग्स को लिखो और समझो।

scenes.text: Pehle timer set karo, breath lo, aur feeling label karo.
scenes.text_en: First set a timer, take a breath, and label the feeling.
scenes.text_hi: पहले टाइमर सेट करो, ब्रीथ लो, और फीलिंग लेबल करो।

scenes.text: Aaj hi counselor se baat karo.
scenes.text_hi: आज ही काउंसलर से बात करो।

data.description: Understanding persistent low mood in teens. A quick guide to identifying signs and taking the first step towards feeling better.

fixes: Reduce first line to ≤9 words, e.g., "Koi nahi batata ki mahino tak sad rehna warning hai"
Add a specific Indian context like board exam pressure or IT job stress
Replace medical claim with relatable description, avoid naming dysthymia
End with a single clear CTA: "Aaj hi counselor se baat karo"
